title: zone/applicable/v1
description: One ED-318 zone as judged applicable at `at` by a system's CIS cache (spec 04 §3.4), in the common envelope. Produced by several systems (decision record M14). `cis_applicability` is the CISP's `?applies_at=` annotation (M17); `applies` is this system's judgement.

identifier.description: ED-318 `identifier`, at most 7 characters (uspace-core `ed318`; decision record M10).

type.description: ED-318 `CodeZoneType`, ED-318 spelling. Pinned to uspace-core `core.ZoneType`.

applies.description: Whether this system judges the zone applicable at `at`.

cis_applicability.description: `extendedProperties.cis_applicability` of the CISP read API with `?applies_at=` (decision record M17).

version.description: The zone's version as published in the CIS.

at.description: The instant the applicability was evaluated (04 §3.4).

cis_version.description: The CIS dataset version the judgement used (04 §3.4).
